scenario: Two staff members edit the same database record with EF Core. The second save must not silently overwrite the first. Explain your approach and conflict handling.
rubric: Use a concurrency token and compare the original token during the update.
Handle DbUpdateConcurrencyException rather than silently losing an update.
Describe a deliberate reload, merge or user resolution strategy.
misconceptions: A concurrency token automatically merges every conflict.

sources.title: Handling concurrency conflicts
sources.claim: Concurrency tokens detect conflicting updates; applications must handle the resulting exception.

follow_ups.scenario: What would you do if both editors changed different fields?
rubric: Explain an explicit merge policy and retry with fresh concurrency information.
